def policy_code(observation, policy_state):
    # Observation layout:
    # 0:2   root position (x, y) in world
    # 2     root yaw in world
    # 3:6   root velocity (vx_local, vy_local, wz_local)
    # 6:9   left ee pos in torso frame
    # 9:12  right ee pos in torso frame
    # 12    torso height
    # 13    gate1_y
    # 14    gate2_y
    # 15:25 last action

    device = observation.device
    num_envs = observation.shape[0]

    if policy_state is None:
        policy_state = {
            "needs_init": torch.ones(num_envs, dtype=torch.bool, device=device),
            "phase": torch.zeros(num_envs, dtype=torch.long, device=device),   # 0->gate1, 1->gate2, 2->goal
            "target_y": torch.zeros(num_envs, device=device),
            "filtered_yaw_err": torch.zeros(num_envs, device=device),
            "crouch_hold": torch.zeros(num_envs, device=device),
        }

    reset_mask = policy_state["needs_init"]

    root_x = observation[:, 0]
    root_y = observation[:, 1]
    yaw = observation[:, 2]
    vx_local = observation[:, 3]
    vy_local = observation[:, 4]
    torso_height_obs = observation[:, 12]
    gate1_y = observation[:, 13]
    gate2_y = observation[:, 14]

    # Initialize/reset per-env state
    if reset_mask.any():
        policy_state["phase"][reset_mask] = 0
        policy_state["target_y"][reset_mask] = gate1_y[reset_mask]
        policy_state["filtered_yaw_err"][reset_mask] = 0.0
        policy_state["crouch_hold"][reset_mask] = 0.0

    policy_state["needs_init"][reset_mask] = False

    phase = policy_state["phase"]

    # Phase transitions based on progress in x
    passed_gate1 = root_x > -1.15
    passed_gate2 = root_x > 2.15

    to_phase1 = (phase == 0) & passed_gate1
    to_phase2 = (phase == 1) & passed_gate2

    phase = torch.where(to_phase1, torch.ones_like(phase), phase)
    phase = torch.where(to_phase2, torch.full_like(phase, 2), phase)

    policy_state["phase"] = phase

    # Current navigation target
    gate_x = torch.where(
        phase == 0,
        torch.full_like(root_x, -1.67),
        torch.where(phase == 1, torch.full_like(root_x, 1.67), torch.full_like(root_x, 4.5))
    )

    target_y = torch.where(
        phase == 0,
        gate1_y,
        torch.where(phase == 1, gate2_y, torch.zeros_like(root_y))
    )
    policy_state["target_y"] = target_y

    dx = gate_x - root_x
    dy = target_y - root_y

    # Desired heading:
    # - Far before a gate, steer mostly toward a staging point offset in x and target y.
    # - Near the gate, face east and use lateral velocity to align precisely with opening.
    near_gate = ((phase == 0) & (torch.abs(root_x + 1.67) < 0.9)) | ((phase == 1) & (torch.abs(root_x - 1.67) < 0.9))
    final_run = phase == 2

    desired_heading = torch.where(
        near_gate | final_run,
        torch.zeros_like(yaw),
        torch.atan2(dy, torch.clamp(dx, min=0.05))
    )

    yaw_err = desired_heading - yaw
    yaw_err = torch.atan2(torch.sin(yaw_err), torch.cos(yaw_err))

    # Smooth yaw error a bit
    filtered_yaw_err = 0.7 * policy_state["filtered_yaw_err"] + 0.3 * yaw_err
    policy_state["filtered_yaw_err"] = filtered_yaw_err

    # Crouch logic around gate crossing
    gate_dist_x = torch.where(
        phase == 0,
        torch.abs(root_x + 1.67),
        torch.where(phase == 1, torch.abs(root_x - 1.67), torch.full_like(root_x, 10.0))
    )
    need_crouch_zone = gate_dist_x < 0.85
    crouch_hold = torch.where(
        need_crouch_zone,
        torch.full_like(policy_state["crouch_hold"], 1.0),
        torch.clamp(policy_state["crouch_hold"] - 0.1, min=0.0)
    )
    policy_state["crouch_hold"] = crouch_hold
    crouching = crouch_hold > 0.0

    # Velocity command design:
    # Near gates, prioritize straight east motion with accurate y-centering and low yaw error.
    # Else, move toward target with moderate speed.
    y_err = target_y - root_y

    vx_cmd = torch.where(
        near_gate,
        0.55 - 0.20 * torch.abs(y_err) - 0.10 * torch.abs(filtered_yaw_err),
        torch.where(final_run, 0.8 * torch.ones_like(root_x), 0.65 * torch.ones_like(root_x))
    )

    # Slow down close to final goal
    goal_dx = 4.5 - root_x
    vx_cmd = torch.where(final_run & (goal_dx < 1.0), 0.35 + 0.45 * torch.clamp(goal_dx, min=0.0), vx_cmd)

    # Lateral control in local frame:
    # when near gate, use direct centering aggressively
    vy_cmd = torch.where(
        near_gate,
        1.6 * y_err,
        0.9 * y_err
    )

    # If badly misaligned in yaw, reduce forward speed and allow correction
    bad_yaw = torch.abs(filtered_yaw_err) > 0.45
    vx_cmd = torch.where(bad_yaw & (~near_gate), 0.35 * vx_cmd, vx_cmd)

    wz_cmd = 1.8 * filtered_yaw_err + 0.15 * (-observation[:, 5])

    # Extra safety: if very close to a gate but laterally off-center, slow more
    very_near_gate = gate_dist_x < 0.35
    offcenter = torch.abs(y_err) > 0.18
    vx_cmd = torch.where(very_near_gate & offcenter, torch.full_like(vx_cmd, 0.18), vx_cmd)

    # Stop at end of room
    at_goal = root_x > 4.35
    vx_cmd = torch.where(at_goal, torch.zeros_like(vx_cmd), vx_cmd)
    vy_cmd = torch.where(at_goal, torch.zeros_like(vy_cmd), vy_cmd)
    wz_cmd = torch.where(at_goal, -0.8 * yaw, wz_cmd)

    # Torso height: crouch under lintel near gates
    torso_height_cmd = torch.where(crouching, torch.full_like(root_x, 0.62), torch.full_like(root_x, 0.9))

    # Arm posture:
    # Keep arms forward but tucked inward and lower during gate passage to reduce envelope.
    left_x = torch.where(crouching, torch.full_like(root_x, 0.20), torch.full_like(root_x, 0.24))
    left_y = torch.where(crouching, torch.full_like(root_x, 0.16), torch.full_like(root_x, 0.20))
    left_z = torch.where(crouching, torch.full_like(root_x, 0.02), torch.full_like(root_x, 0.10))

    right_x = torch.where(crouching, torch.full_like(root_x, 0.20), torch.full_like(root_x, 0.24))
    right_y = torch.where(crouching, torch.full_like(root_x, -0.16), torch.full_like(root_x, -0.20))
    right_z = torch.where(crouching, torch.full_like(root_x, 0.02), torch.full_like(root_x, 0.10))

    # Small damping using current local velocities
    vx_cmd = vx_cmd - 0.10 * torch.clamp(vx_local - vx_cmd, min=-1.0, max=1.0)
    vy_cmd = vy_cmd - 0.12 * torch.clamp(vy_local - vy_cmd, min=-1.0, max=1.0)

    # Clamp to action bounds
    vx_cmd = torch.clamp(vx_cmd, -0.6, 1.0)
    vy_cmd = torch.clamp(vy_cmd, -0.5, 0.5)
    wz_cmd = torch.clamp(wz_cmd, -1.0, 1.0)

    left_x = torch.clamp(left_x, 0.15, 0.45)
    left_y = torch.clamp(left_y, 0.10, 0.38)
    left_z = torch.clamp(left_z, -0.1, 0.5)

    right_x = torch.clamp(right_x, 0.15, 0.45)
    right_y = torch.clamp(right_y, -0.38, -0.1)
    right_z = torch.clamp(right_z, -0.1, 0.5)

    torso_height_cmd = torch.clamp(torso_height_cmd, 0.5, 0.95)

    action = torch.stack(
        [
            vx_cmd,
            vy_cmd,
            wz_cmd,
            left_x,
            left_y,
            left_z,
            right_x,
            right_y,
            right_z,
            torso_height_cmd,
        ],
        dim=-1,
    )

    return action, policy_state
